title: looking to collaborate with algo developers
author: RNAlgotrading

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body:
Out of sample by default is genuinely rare and most platforms never ship it that way, so good. My push would be on costs, since honest looking results tend to die there quietly rather than loudly. One minute broker data makes the entry timestamp believable, but the fill is still a modelled number, and spread plus slippage on a thin name at the open behaves nothing like spread on SPY at 11am.

No order execution is a real constraint and I would keep it. The moment a platform can place orders, every design decision starts bending toward making the curve look good.

comments.author: RNAlgotrading
comments.body:
Hi, Thanks for your valuable reply. Yes,, Since my 20+ years of experience focusing on Algorithmic Trading Strategies and backtesting, optimization walk forward and usage of Multiple Platforms, I decided to stick RN TradeLab with Purely Backtesting engine with more advanced features. Also platform encourages students who want to learn Algorithmic Trading Strategies and backtesting using simple Python code, so they can be confident working with data, indicators, strategies,walk forward backtesting, optimization, portfolio construction and much more.. It's a free educational Research platform with few advanced features for gold users. 

Always open to help  students and Algorithmic developers who would like to explore something new. 

Thanks again,
